keyPoints.en: To replace the Malayan Union, Britain set up a Working Committee (Jawatankuasa Kerja) in 1946 with British officials, representatives of the Malay rulers and UMNO.
keyPoints.bm: Untuk menggantikan Malayan Union, British menubuhkan Jawatankuasa Kerja pada 1946 yang dianggotai pegawai British, wakil raja-raja Melayu dan UMNO.

keyPoints.en: A Consultative Committee then collected the views of other communities.
keyPoints.bm: Jawatankuasa Perundingan kemudian mengumpul pandangan kaum-kaum lain.

keyPoints.en: Radical Malay nationalists (PKMM, API, AWAS) joined non-Malay groups (AMCJA) as PUTERA–AMCJA and drafted the People's Constitution (1947).
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalis Melayu radikal (PKMM, API, AWAS) bergabung dengan kumpulan bukan Melayu (AMCJA) sebagai PUTERA–AMCJA dan menggubal Perlembagaan Rakyat (1947).

keyPoints.en: On 20 October 1947 PUTERA–AMCJA held a nationwide hartal, but Britain rejected their proposals.
keyPoints.bm: Pada 20 Oktober 1947 PUTERA–AMCJA mengadakan hartal seluruh negara, tetapi British menolak cadangan mereka.

meaning.en: 12 members — 6 British officials, 4 representatives of the rulers and 2 of UMNO — who drafted the new federation.
meaning.bm: 12 ahli — 6 pegawai British, 4 wakil raja-raja dan 2 wakil UMNO — yang merangka persekutuan baharu.

meaning.en: Parti Kebangsaan Melayu Malaya (1945), a radical Malay party led later by Dr Burhanuddin al-Helmy.
meaning.bm: Parti Kebangsaan Melayu Malaya (1945), parti Melayu radikal yang kemudian dipimpin Dr Burhanuddin al-Helmy.

meaning.en: Angkatan Pemuda Insaf (Ahmad Boestamam) and Angkatan Wanita Sedar (Shamsiah Fakeh) — PKMM's youth and women's wings.
meaning.bm: Angkatan Pemuda Insaf (Ahmad Boestamam) dan Angkatan Wanita Sedar (Shamsiah Fakeh) — sayap pemuda dan wanita PKMM.

meaning.en: Pusat Tenaga Rakyat (1947) — a coalition of radical Malay groups.
meaning.bm: Pusat Tenaga Rakyat (1947) — gabungan kumpulan Melayu radikal.

meaning.en: All-Malaya Council of Joint Action (1946), led by Tan Cheng Lock.
meaning.bm: Majlis Bertindak Bersama Se-Malaya (1946), dipimpin Tan Cheng Lock.

meaning.en: A general strike in which shops and businesses close in protest.
meaning.bm: Mogok umum apabila kedai dan perniagaan ditutup sebagai bantahan.

heading.en: a. Setting up the Working Committee

points.en: Formed in 1946 to draft a new constitution acceptable to the rulers and UMNO.
points.bm: Ditubuhkan pada 1946 untuk merangka perlembagaan baharu yang diterima raja-raja dan UMNO.

heading.en: b–d. Radical Malay nationalists and PUTERA–AMCJA
heading.bm: b–d. Nasionalis Melayu radikal dan PUTERA–AMCJA

points.en: PKMM, API and AWAS rejected the Working Committee because only UMNO and the rulers were included.
points.bm: PKMM, API dan AWAS menolak Jawatankuasa Kerja kerana hanya UMNO dan raja-raja disertakan.

points.en: PUTERA (Malay radicals) joined AMCJA (mostly non-Malay groups) in 1947.
points.bm: PUTERA (radikal Melayu) bergabung dengan AMCJA (kebanyakannya kumpulan bukan Melayu) pada 1947.

points.en: Their contribution: they raised the idea of independence, a united nation and elected government.
points.bm: Sumbangan mereka: mengetengahkan idea kemerdekaan, satu bangsa yang bersatu dan kerajaan yang dipilih.

points.en: Singapore to be part of the federation; an elected Legislative Council.
points.bm: Singapura menjadi sebahagian persekutuan; Majlis Perundangan yang dipilih.

points.en: Common citizenship called "Melayu"; Malay as the national language.
points.bm: Kewarganegaraan bersama yang dinamakan "Melayu"; bahasa Melayu sebagai bahasa kebangsaan.

points.en: Malay rulers as constitutional rulers; a national flag in red and white.
points.bm: Raja-raja Melayu sebagai raja berperlembagaan; bendera kebangsaan berwarna merah dan putih.

question.en: Why did PUTERA–AMCJA oppose the Working Committee's proposals?
question.bm: Mengapakah PUTERA–AMCJA menentang cadangan Jawatankuasa Kerja?

answer.en: They were left out of the talks, which included only the British, the rulers and UMNO; they wanted an elected government, a common citizenship and Singapore to be included.
answer.bm: Mereka tidak dilibatkan dalam rundingan yang hanya disertai British, raja-raja dan UMNO; mereka mahukan kerajaan yang dipilih, kewarganegaraan bersama dan Singapura dimasukkan.

keyPoints.en: Three factors led to the Federation of Malaya 1948: Malay opposition to the Malayan Union, proposals by the rulers and UMNO, and support from British administrators.
keyPoints.bm: Tiga faktor membawa kepada Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1948: penentangan orang Melayu terhadap Malayan Union, cadangan raja-raja Melayu dan UMNO, serta sokongan pentadbir British.

meaning.en: An agreement where each side gives up something.
meaning.bm: Persetujuan apabila setiap pihak bertolak ansur.

heading.en: a. Malay opposition to the Malayan Union
heading.bm: a. Penentangan orang Melayu terhadap Malayan Union

points.en: United protests by the rulers and people showed the Union could not work.
points.bm: Bantahan bersatu raja-raja dan rakyat menunjukkan Union tidak dapat dilaksanakan.

heading.en: b. Proposals by the rulers and UMNO
heading.bm: b. Cadangan raja-raja Melayu dan UMNO

points.en: They proposed a federation that restored the rulers' sovereignty, tightened citizenship and protected the Malays' special position.
points.bm: Mereka mencadangkan persekutuan yang mengembalikan kedaulatan raja, mengetatkan kewarganegaraan dan melindungi kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu.

points.en: Officials such as Governor Edward Gent and Malcolm MacDonald saw that British interests needed Malay cooperation.
points.bm: Pegawai seperti Gabenor Edward Gent dan Malcolm MacDonald sedar bahawa kepentingan British memerlukan kerjasama orang Melayu.

points.en: Former officials in Britain also pressed London to change course.
points.bm: Bekas pegawai di Britain turut mendesak London mengubah dasar.

question.en: Why was UMNO's place on the Working Committee historically important?
question.bm: Mengapakah kedudukan UMNO dalam Jawatankuasa Kerja penting dari segi sejarah?

answer.en: For the first time a local political party negotiated directly with the British on the country's constitution — an early step towards self-government.
answer.bm: Buat pertama kali sebuah parti politik tempatan berunding terus dengan British tentang perlembagaan negara — langkah awal ke arah pemerintahan sendiri.

keyPoints.en: The Federation of Malaya began on 1 February 1948: the nine Malay states plus Penang and Melaka.
keyPoints.bm: Persekutuan Tanah Melayu bermula pada 1 Februari 1948: sembilan negeri Melayu serta Pulau Pinang dan Melaka.

keyPoints.en: Head of government: a British High Commissioner (first: Sir Edward Gent).
keyPoints.bm: Ketua kerajaan: Pesuruhjaya Tinggi British (yang pertama: Sir Edward Gent).

keyPoints.en: The Malay rulers' sovereignty was restored; they met in the Conference of Rulers (Majlis Raja-Raja).
keyPoints.bm: Kedaulatan raja-raja Melayu dikembalikan; mereka bersidang dalam Majlis Raja-Raja.

keyPoints.en: Citizenship rules were stricter than under the Malayan Union, and the Malays' special position was protected.
keyPoints.bm: Syarat kewarganegaraan lebih ketat daripada Malayan Union, dan kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu dilindungi.

meaning.en: Britain's representative who headed the Federation government.
meaning.bm: Wakil British yang mengetuai kerajaan Persekutuan.

meaning.en: Meeting of the Malay rulers, set up under the 1948 Federation.
meaning.bm: Persidangan raja-raja Melayu, ditubuhkan di bawah Persekutuan 1948.

meaning.en: Chief executive of each Malay state, advised by a British Adviser.
meaning.bm: Ketua eksekutif setiap negeri Melayu, dinasihati Penasihat British.

meaning.en: Law-making body of the Federation, chaired by the High Commissioner.
meaning.bm: Badan pembuat undang-undang Persekutuan, dipengerusikan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi.

points.en: Federal government led by the High Commissioner, with a Federal Executive Council.
points.bm: Kerajaan pusat diketuai Pesuruhjaya Tinggi, dengan Majlis Mesyuarat Kerja Persekutuan.

points.en: States kept their own governments under a Menteri Besar; Penang and Melaka under a Resident Commissioner.
points.bm: Negeri mengekalkan kerajaan sendiri di bawah Menteri Besar; Pulau Pinang dan Melaka di bawah Pesuruhjaya Residen.

heading.en: b. Powers of the Malay rulers

points.en: Rulers were again sovereign heads of their states and heads of Islam and Malay custom.
points.bm: Raja-raja kembali menjadi ketua negeri yang berdaulat serta ketua agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

points.en: The High Commissioner had to consult the Conference of Rulers on key matters such as immigration.
points.bm: Pesuruhjaya Tinggi perlu berunding dengan Majlis Raja-Raja dalam perkara penting seperti imigresen.

points.en: Federal Legislative Council of 75 members, all appointed (no elections yet).
points.bm: Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan dengan 75 ahli, semuanya dilantik (belum ada pilihan raya).

points.en: Automatic for subjects of the rulers and certain others born here.
points.bm: Secara automatik bagi rakyat raja dan sesetengah yang lahir di sini.

points.en: Others had to apply: long residence (e.g. 8 of 12 years for those born here, 15 of 20 for others), good conduct, Malay or English, and an oath of loyalty.
points.bm: Orang lain perlu memohon: bermastautin lama (cth. 8 daripada 12 tahun bagi yang lahir di sini, 15 daripada 20 bagi yang lain), berkelakuan baik, boleh berbahasa Melayu atau Inggeris, dan mengangkat sumpah taat setia.

question.en: How was citizenship under the Federation 1948 different from the Malayan Union?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah kewarganegaraan di bawah Persekutuan 1948 berbeza daripada Malayan Union?

answer.en: The Union used liberal jus soli; the Federation was stricter — non-Malays had to meet residence, language and loyalty conditions.
answer.bm: Union menggunakan jus soli yang longgar; Persekutuan lebih ketat — bukan Melayu perlu memenuhi syarat bermastautin, bahasa dan taat setia.

tip.en: Remember the four headings: Pentadbiran, Kuasa raja, Perundangan, Kewarganegaraan.
tip.bm: Ingat empat tajuk: Pentadbiran, Kuasa raja, Perundangan, Kewarganegaraan.

keyPoints.en: The Federation restored the position of the Malay rulers.
It protected the special position of the Malays.
keyPoints.bm: Ia menjaga kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu.

keyPoints.en: It opened a path to citizenship for non-Malays who met the conditions.
keyPoints.bm: Ia membuka ruang kewarganegaraan kepada bukan Melayu yang memenuhi syarat.

keyPoints.en: It encouraged cooperation between ethnic groups, which later led to the Alliance and independence.
keyPoints.bm: Ia menggalakkan kerjasama kaum, yang kemudian membawa kepada Perikatan dan kemerdekaan.

meaning.en: Protection of the Malays' rights, e.g. in land, the civil service and education.
meaning.bm: Perlindungan hak orang Melayu, cth. dalam tanah, perkhidmatan awam dan pendidikan.

points.en: a. Rulers again sovereign and respected as heads of their states.
points.bm: a. Raja-raja kembali berdaulat dan dihormati sebagai ketua negeri.

points.en: b. The Malays' special position written into the agreement.
points.bm: b. Kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu termaktub dalam perjanjian.

points.en: c. More non-Malays could become citizens over time.
points.bm: c. Lebih ramai bukan Melayu boleh menjadi warganegara dari semasa ke semasa.

points.en: d. Leaders began working across ethnic lines (e.g. the Communities Liaison Committee, 1949).
points.bm: d. Pemimpin mula bekerjasama merentas kaum (cth. Jawatankuasa Hubungan Antara Kaum, 1949).

question.en: Which feature of the 1948 Federation still exists in Malaysia today?
question.bm: Ciri Persekutuan 1948 yang manakah masih wujud di Malaysia hari ini?

answer.en: The Conference of Rulers, the federal system (federal and state governments) and the special position of the Malays.
answer.bm: Majlis Raja-Raja, sistem persekutuan (kerajaan pusat dan negeri) dan kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu.
